content.short: Skills Labs is a community-driven investment venture on Cardano providing weekly dividends to holders.
content.description: Skills Labs ($SKILL) is a specialized decentralized finance (DeFi) project on Cardano that operates as a community-managed investment treasury. The protocol focuses on generating value by investing its bootstrapped resources into various high-quality positions across the Cardano ecosystem. Profits from these strategic investments are distributed back to $SKILL token holders and associated NFT investors through weekly dividends. By combining treasury management with a DAO structure, Skills Labs empowers its community to participate in professional-grade wealth creation.
